tasks.label: Build lexer
tasks.command: win_flex -o lexer/lex.yy.cpp lexer/lexer.l; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { g++ lexer/lex.yy.cpp lexer/extension/logger/Logger.cpp lexer/extension/buffer/Buffer.cpp lexer/extension/Parser/Parser.cpp -o lexer/lexer.exe 2>&1 }

tasks.label: Test selected lexer
tasks.command: $files = @(Get-ChildItem tests\lexer\*.txt -Recurse); if ($files.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'No lexer tests found'; exit 1 }; for ($i = 0; $i -lt $files.Count; $i++) { $relative = Resolve-Path -Relative $files[$i].FullName; Write-Host "[$($i + 1)] $relative" }; $choice = [int](Read-Host 'Select test') - 1; if ($choice -lt 0 -or $choice -ge $files.Count) { Write-Host 'Invalid selection'; exit 1 }; $selected = Resolve-Path -Relative $files[$choice].FullName; Write-Host "`n=== $selected ==="; .\lexer\lexer.exe $files[$choice].FullName
